detail_observations.text: "Let me explain my interest in this matter," Grom says. "As I said, I'm from a noble house in New Targonor. I'm came here to Halgarad for a couple reasons, one being that my house's enemy is already here." "The second though, is to understand your culture. This is an interesting situation and, from what I understand, not a regular occurrence. I would like you to go to this man's house and see what you can find there. It may be dangerous, but I have no reason to believe he would return to his home now."

pages.article_html:
Investigative Measures

Level 4 · Diplomacy · Halgarad · Thestra

The Stone Mug Tavern

Objectives

Go to Reingraf's home and see what you can find out. Return to Grom Vermach when complete. - Speak to Aleskrag Karn - Look Around the Back of the House

Description

"Let me explain my interest in this matter," Grom says. "As I said, I'm from a noble house in New Targonor. I'm came here to Halgarad for a couple reasons, one being that my house's enemy is already here." "The second though, is to understand your culture. This is an interesting situation and, from what I understand, not a regular occurrence. I would like you to go to this man's house and see what you can find there. It may be dangerous, but I have no reason to believe he would return to his home now."

What they say

On taking it

Grom Vermach
"Let me explain my interest in this matter," Grom says. "As I said, I'm from a noble house in New Tangonor. I came here to Halgarad for a couple of reasons, one being that my house's ememy is already here." "The second though, is to understand your culture. This is an interesting situation and, from what I understand, not a regular occurrence. I would like you to go to this man's house and see what you can find there. It may be dangerous, but I have no reason to believe he would return to his home now."

Recorded by wiki.silkyvenom.com.

Notes

Head to Reingrafs burned house. ===Aleskrag Karn=== location: Investigative Measures :4 <gallery widths="175" orientation="portrait" spacing="small" captionalign="left"> Good point.JPG Moral authority.JPG Domestic's dispute.JPG A friend indeed.JPG </gallery> After a successful parley, investigate behind the house. Read quickly. Return to Grom Vermach.

findings.observation: Heading displays Level 4, Diplomacy, Halgarad and Thestra. Two attributed disagreements identify ends npc (wiki.silkyvenom.com:80) and loc (fandom); alternative field values are absent. Details and primary objectives name Grom Vermach as turn-in, but the disagreement remains unresolved.

Primary objectives direct a visit to Reingraf home, speaking to Aleskrag Karn, looking around the back and returning to Grom. The fandom account spells the home owner Teingraf. Preserve both spellings; no identity correction is justified.

Notes describe Reingrafs burned house, successful parley, investigation behind the house and Read quickly. No explicit parley parameters, investigation trigger or timer duration are supplied. Notes retain an empty location label; Details separately records 10632, 52180, 52002.

Gallery markup retains Good point.JPG, Moral authority.JPG, Domestic's dispute.JPG and A friend indeed.JPG. These filenames do not establish canonical card identities, rewards or a complete encounter deck.

Description and Silky Venom taking-dialogue have transcription variants including New Targonor versus New Tangonor and enemy versus ememy. Preserve source attribution rather than treating mirrored text as independent corroboration.

Details displays Series Thestran Web Quests but Chain Thestra Web Quests, Previous A Bad Equation For Murder and Next Exchanging Information. These are navigation labels, not verified enforced prerequisites. Repeatable yes is an observation; Coin reward 50 has no denomination.
